import os,re,json
from collections import defaultdict,Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# First check: does output == input except zeros filled? and what are output zeros?
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[name+' input']; go=G[name+' output']
    ok=all(go[i][j]==gi[i][j] or gi[i][j]==0 for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])))
    nz=[(i,j,gi[i][j],go[i][j]) for i in range(len(gi)) for j in range(len(gi[0])) if gi[i][j]==0 and go[i][j]!=0]
    print(name,'output-all-filled?',ok,'nz filled count',len(nz),'sample',nz[:3])

def solve(g_in):

    g=[row[:] for row in g_in]
    # find band row: row with many 4s besides header; use row where 4 count maximal among rows

        n=len(vals); L=None
        # try all periods p dividing... just brute force p from 2..W-1

            ok=True; M={}
            for j,v in zip(js,vals):

                # align: assume row starts its own cyclic seq at j=js[0]; map j-> (j - js[0]) mod p

                kk=(j-js[0])%L if False else (j-js[0])%L
                row[j]=M[(j-js[0])%L] if False else M.get((j-js[0])%L,0)
